text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To reduce rule violations, it's important 
to address the root cause, ya know...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Other things we could do besides 
cracking down... Like bowing deeply and 
politely asking them to follow school 
rules...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe we could increase the greeting 
campaign to raise awareness...?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, if we get rid of the school 
rules, there won't be any violations 
either...? No, but if we do that, public 
order will collapse..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess I'll just try doing all of it! 
Alright, time for bed—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah?! It's morning already?! I totally 
messed up, ssu~!!
